fields.Name: T350 - Dependency Graph Search and Schema Filter
fields.Description: Exercises applyFilter over metadata entities combined with inline mj-filter-chip schema chips and toggle semantics (OnSchemaFilterChange) — a distinct inline-chip filter UI, unlike the popover filters used on Labels/Restore.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Version History app → Dependency Graph (left nav), type into the 'Filter entities...' box and confirm the entity list narrows responsively. If schema filter chips are shown above the list, click one to filter the entities to that schema and confirm the list narrows and the chip becomes active; click it again (or clear the search) to restore the full list. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Typing in the entity filter box responsively narrows the entity list
Clicking a schema filter chip (when present) narrows the list to that schema and toggles its active state
Clearing the search/schema restores the full entity list
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
